auditor.description: Installation-wide audit and health (owner, admin or auditor).

permissions.description: Management permissions held at tenant scope (system catalogue subset).

images.description: The background images Porch currently holds.

title.description: Shown on the sign-in page ("Welcome to …").

access_mode.description: all_members: every active member (and shared tenants); assigned: explicit app:access grants only.

forward_headers.description: Identity headers sent to forward-auth backends (header → sub|email|name|groups|tenant|roles); empty = defaults.

group.description: Launcher section the application appears in (empty = none).

hosts.description: Hosts protected by a forward_auth application.

icon_ref.description: The icon URL or dashboard-icons name the icon was taken from.

icon_source.description: How the icon was set (empty = no icon: a letter tile).

icon_url.description: Where Porch serves the stored icon (empty = none).

chain_hash_prefix.description: First bytes of the event's chain hash (hex), for cross-checking exports.

sealed_details.description: The event has encrypted details (readable only with host access).

category.description: wikimedia: Commons category, e.g. "Featured pictures of landscapes".

files.description: wikimedia: file names; picsum: photo IDs; url: https image URLs. Empty (wikimedia, picsum) = a random selection.

source.description: wikimedia: Wikimedia Commons (a category or files, credited); picsum: Lorem Picsum photos from Unsplash (random, or photo IDs); url: your own https image URLs.

count.description: How many images to keep, shared across providers.

providers.description: Empty: no backgrounds (Porch makes no image requests).

refresh.description: How often Porch picks a new random selection.

rotation.description: visit: a random image on every page load; daily: one image per day.

titles.description: The user's own recovery titles, in order.

locked_until.description: Set while the backup login is locked out.

identifier.description: Backup handle, or email when no handle is set.

verify_key.description: Ed25519 key that verifies this installation's backups; store it with the age identity.

require_pkce.description: Default true; public clients always require PKCE.

primary_email.description: Attribute only; never used to link login identities.

access_mode.description: all_members: every active member (and shared tenants); assigned: explicit app:access grants only.

client_secret.description: Shown only in this response. Store it now.

forward_headers.description: Identity headers sent to forward-auth backends (header → sub|email|name|groups|tenant|roles); empty = defaults.

group.description: Launcher section the application appears in (empty = none).

hosts.description: Hosts protected by a forward_auth application.

icon_ref.description: The icon URL or dashboard-icons name the icon was taken from.

icon_source.description: How the icon was set (empty = no icon: a letter tile).

icon_url.description: Where Porch serves the stored icon (empty = none).

client_secret.description: Shown only in this response. Store it now.

expires_at.description: Absent when the token never expires.

token.description: Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Shown only in this response.

evidence_kind.description: workspace_hd = validated Google hd claim; verified_email is weaker.

confirm.description: Every answer typed again, in order.

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

handle.description: Empty removes the handle (email works again).

source.description: url: an https image URL (SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP); dashboard_icons: a name from the dashboard-icons set (e.g. grafana); thesvg: a theSVG brand logo, slug or slug/variant (e.g. github/mono); empty removes the icon.

content_base64.description: SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, at most 512 KiB. SVG is sanitized and kept as SVG; other formats are scaled to 256×256 PNG.

allowed_hds.description: Google Workspace domains this provider accepts (empty = any account).

callback_url.description: Register this redirect URI at the provider.

never_expires.description: Issue a token that never expires and does not depend on the identity provider confirming you (installation owners only, ADR-0046). Revoke it when it is no longer needed.

role.description: admin manages every tenant and installation setting; auditor reads.

icon_url.description: The application's icon served by Porch (empty = show a letter tile).

shared.description: Owned by another tenant and shared with yours.

direct_provider.description: Slug of an enabled provider the sign-in page sends people to directly; empty shows every sign-in method. /login?all=1 always shows them.

csrf_token.description: Send as X-Porch-CSRF on state-changing requests.

allowed_origins.description: Browser origins allowed to call the token endpoint (SPA clients).

audiences.description: API audiences access tokens may be issued for (RFC 8707 resource values).

redirect_uris_exact.description: Always true: redirect URIs match exactly (loopback port exception for native clients).

secret_hint.description: Last characters of the current secret.

custom.description: Permissions used by this tenant's roles that are not system permissions.

actions.description: Deny policies only: permissions it applies to (* for all).

effect.description: condition: referenced by assignments, must be true for them to apply; deny: overrides grants for its actions.

expression.description: expr-lang boolean expression over principal, resource, action, context, now (environment v1).

action.description: Same-origin URL the client should navigate to (re-authentication).

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. validation_failed, not_found, precondition_failed, reauth_required.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type.

background.description: The background to show now, with its credit; null when backgrounds are off or not fetched yet.

title.description: Your own hint, like a security question.

type.description: Lowercase identifier; app and tenant are reserved.

includes.description: IDs of roles bundled into this one (DAG, depth ≤ 5).

permissions.description: <resource_type>:<action>; either side may be *. Built-in roles keep their permissions.

overlap_seconds.description: How long the old key stays published (default 24h).

audiences.description: API audiences its access tokens may target (RFC 8707 resource values).

token.description: Setup token printed by 'porch admin setup-token'.

session_absolute_seconds.description: Shortens members' absolute session lifetime (0 = installation default; the strictest tenant wins).

session_idle_seconds.description: Shortens members' idle timeout (0 = installation default; the strictest tenant of a member wins).

permissions.description: Tenant permissions; you must hold each of them.

expires_at.description: Absent when the token never expires.

icon.description: Replaces the icon; source empty removes it.

public_id.description: Stable OIDC subject (sub) of this user.

info.description: Management API for Porch. Browser clients authenticate with the __Host-porch_session cookie and send the session's CSRF token in X-Porch-CSRF on state-changing requests. Automation clients use `Authorization: Bearer porch_at_…` (automation tokens; no CSRF header needed).
